summary: Iteration 7 (speed-up + hands-free mic + parking follow-up + onboarding regression). Backend: 102/102 pytest pass on a cold cache (backend restarted first). Latency on cold cache: /api/agent 'I need fuel' 4.0s, 'take me to Reno' 1.9s, 'thanks' 1.5s (still status=chat), hotel 5.8s; /api/voice with /tmp/q.mp3 6.8s from pytest and about 6.3-7s from the browser (previously about 20s). Replies follow the templates ('Found Capitol Truck Plaza on I-80 Exit 85, about 4.7 miles away. Route is set.' / 'Route to Reno is set: 2 h 50 min, 132 miles.'). Frontend at 375x667 with a fake mic: on the main map the mic stops by itself (POST /api/voice about 2.7s after the tap), tapping again stops it early (POST at 1.6s), Close cancels with no request, and a silent mic shows the 'Sorry, I didn't catch that. Try again.' toast at about 7.6s. Parking follow-up: when the cache is cold the app calls /api/parking right after the voice reply and the card updates once the reply has finished playing. With /api/parking mocked: tips mode shows a second caption and calls /api/speak with the tips; unlikely mode shows the 'Heads up... tight for a rig' caption; a 500 leaves the route intact with 'Truck parking unclear'. Onboarding runs as an automatic conversation through every step to the map in about 51s. Tapping the avatar after silence listens within 0.7s without repeating the question. 'Sorry, I didn't catch that.' is visible during the re-ask, and the truck hint shows before the driver answers. Regression checks passed: options list, per-option parking check, routing to an option, End route, truck-profile editor save, menu reopening onboarding, Skip. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView issues found.

minor.issue: No in-flight de-duplication. Each search starts 3 background vision checks, and the app then calls /api/parking for the chosen place while that place's check is still running, so the same place is checked twice at the same time. Backend log 03:58:08.9 and 03:58:10.7 show two 'parking Capitol Truck Plaza ->' checks for one UI turn. This doubles vision LLM cost, /api/parking gains nothing from the warm-up, and because verdicts vary between runs the second result overwrites the first in the cache.

The cache is keyed by text but is only filled once synthesis finishes. When the same text arrives while it is still being generated, it is synthesized again: two concurrent calls took 1.2s and 2.4s, and a cached call takes 0.1s. Onboarding pre-generates the truck line only about 1.1s before it is needed (onboarding.tsx:184 and the 1100ms pause at :239), so that pre-generation is mostly wasted (seen as duplicate speak calls at t=29.0 and t=30.1).

With verdict 'unclear' the vision model sometimes fills entry_tip/park_tip with negative text ('No suitable semi entrance visible' / 'No suitable truck parking visible'). The card shows these as directions, and followParking would speak them as tips.

ui_bugs.component: Parking follow-up when parking is already cached
ui_bugs.issue: If /api/voice returns cached parking (image_path set), followParking is skipped (index.tsx:195), so entry/park tips are never spoken. The first visit speaks the directions and later visits are silent.

The /api/parking result is held until the spoken reply finishes (Promise.all with replyDone, index.tsx:130). The card shows 'Truck parking unclear' for about 2s after the result arrived (parking returned at 13.3s, card updated at 15.4s). The card could update right away and only the speech wait for the reply.

action_items: parking.py: add an in-flight map (key -> asyncio.Task/Future) so check_parking calls for the same place share one task. This also lets /api/parking reuse the background warm-up.

server.py /api/speak: de-duplicate in-flight synthesis per text, e.g. store a Future in _SPEAK_CACHE. Start the truck/done line pre-generation earlier (on mount, with a generic line or once the name transcript arrives).
Parking vision prompt/parse: set entry_tip/park_tip to null when they describe absence ('No suitable ...').
index.tsx followParking: update the card as soon as /api/parking returns and wait for replyDone only before speaking. Also speak the cached tips when res.parking is already present.

onboarding.tsx truck Type-instead layout: remove the empty status-box space or scroll the inputs into view so all 4 inputs and the error fit above the footer at 375x667 (still open from iteration 6 low #2/#6).
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py: templated replies remove the final LLM round. Tool results for any tool calls left in the same batch are skipped after 'done', which is fine because no further LLM call follows.
agent.py:182 starts 3 vision checks on every search even if the driver never looks at them, about 3x vision cost per request. Consider warming only the chosen place plus 1-2 more.
useVoice.listen: hands-free logic is sound (token cancel, finishNow, fixed 7s window when no meter is available).

seed_data_creation: None. Fake-mic fixtures /tmp/q.mp3, reno.mp3, gib.mp3, onb_*.mp3 reused; fake mic script at /tmp/fakemic.js (supports window.__seq for per-getUserMedia clips and 'silence').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before pytest. Restart the backend first if you want cold-cache latency, because the parking verdict cache is in memory. Mock places always return Capitol Truck Plaza for fuel, so after the first run /api/voice returns cached parking and the app skips the /api/parking follow-up. To test the follow-up, intercept /api/voice in Playwright and set parking=null (route.fetch + fulfill). Onboarding is bypassed with add_init_script localStorage.setItem('onboarded_v1','true'). /tmp/fakemic.js: window.__next selects the clip, or window.__seq=[...] picks a clip per getUserMedia call ('silence' gives low noise).
rca_of_issue: Duplicate parking checks: agent._background(check_parking) and /api/parking both call check_parking, which only checks _verdict_cache before calling the vision LLM. There is no shared pending task, so concurrent callers for the same key each call the LLM. Duplicate TTS has the same cause: _SPEAK_CACHE is only filled after synthesize() returns.
